newsitem.title: USA: U.S. cash soymeal-Basis flat to up in quiet market.
newsitem.headline: U.S. cash soymeal-Basis flat to up in quiet market.

text.p: Rail soymeal offers in cash markets were mostly steady but instances higher Monday in quiet activity as end-users and brokers waited for CBOT October futures to expire on Tuesday, cash brokers said.
"The October and December spread seems to be coming closer together today (Monday) and could possibly be down to $5.00 or $6.00 tomorrow," one cash source said.
After expiration of the CBOT October contract, December could edge higher on Tuesday, one source said.
October soymeal was currently priced too high to attract much buying interest from end users, soymeal brokers said.
Domestic demand for soymeal remains healthy, and that demand is helping to keep basis levels firm, one Indiana broker said.
"I don't see us running out of places to ship soymeal anytime soon," the source said.
